text:
Maya Nguyen: Heads up — HelixCare onboarding call just ended. They raised 4 discrete product/billing pain points. Need a short capture for Product.
Jamal Ortiz: Notes: 1) per-route billing numbers don't reconcile with invoices; 2) embeddings stale -> search misses new SKUs; 3) dashboard times out on 90-day exports; 4) want per-env control for embedding refresh cadence.
Otis Lane: Paste raw quotes and I'll convert to tracker rows.
Maya Nguyen: Quotes below — bucket + severity please. If two or more 'high' mark renewal risk and loop Priya.
"We can't reconcile cost per route — ledger shows different totals than billing UI." — Jaime, Billing
"Search doesn't find our latest SKUs; the index seems out of date." — Rachel, Catalog
"When we pull 90 days the dashboard times out and we have to break into smaller windows." — Sam, Ops
"Would like an env-level toggle to control embedding refresh frequency." — Jaime
Priya Shah: Contract size? That changes prioritization.
Jamal Ortiz: Mid-market, ~45k ARR, onboarding ~3w delayed, Jaime explicitly mentioned renewal concern if billing is unclear.
Maya Nguyen: Renewal risk = medium-high. Proposed mitigations: short-term UI toggle/workaround for billing + a scheduled embedding refresh job; longer-term reconciliation view and indexing SLA.
Otis Lane: I'll produce CSV rows with columns: customer,user_quote,theme,severity,impact_notes,suggested_owner. Jamal, can you map by EOD?
Jamal Ortiz: Yep. Uploading sample now to #cs-uploads. Sample:
HelixCare,"We can't reconcile cost per route — ledger shows different totals than billing UI.",billing,high,"Finance can't forecast; invoices mismatch",Product:billing-ux
HelixCare,"Search doesn't find our latest SKUs; the index seems out of date.",embeddings,medium,"Search relevance degraded",Eng-ML:embeddings
HelixCare,"Dashboard times out on 90-day exports.",performance,low,"Workaround: smaller windows",Eng-Infra:dashboard
HelixCare,"Env-level toggle for embedding refresh frequency needed.",embeddings,low,"Prefers control per env",Eng-ML:embeddings
Priya Shah: If I get owner + severity for top 3 by EOD, I'll slot a lightweight ask into roadmap sync.
Maya Nguyen: Plan: Jamal finishes CSV, Otis drafts a 1-pager for the billing workaround, Priya evaluates priority. CSMs will surface anything else before EOD.
feedback-bot: Ticket PROD-FB-6789 created (HelixCare onboarding capture)
Otis Lane: I'll own the billing toggle PR and UX validation.
Jamal Ortiz: Can schedule 15-min follow with Jaime if Product needs clarifications.
Priya Shah: Acknowledged; will post priority + rough effort estimate by 17:30.
Maya Nguyen: Closing thread — will update renewal tracker after roadmap sync.
